div.div:
Gaps (not drawn):
• Calls between the services, the people and the web entry are on the companion diagram c4-containers-calls.
• The protocol between each service and PostgreSQL, Blob Storage and the Azure AI services is not stated beyond 'managed identity only' (AD-18).
• The two one-off jobs (manual ingestion, classifier training) run the retrieval and classification images (AD-2) and are not drawn as separate containers.
Each element's source is in grey under its name and in its tooltip.
